searchText: I'd like to give a short RFC next all core devs regarding BLS12, my research on it, and my plans moving forward or would it be better to just discuss that here? The more stuff we can move out of the all core dev call the better IMO. That call runs out of time *every* session. At the least, I recommend *starting* here and then bringing it up at ACD call after, to handle as much feedback as possible prior to the ACD call. I'm with <@301186049323958275>. Great to start outside of ACD and then present once it is further along. Very excited to see your work!
